content.title: Dhurandhar 2 Worldwide Box Office Collection Day 6: Did Film CROSS Rs 1000 Cr Mark? Net Vs Gross Earning
content.text: Dhurandhar 2 day 6 worldwide box office collection: It's time to send congratulatory messages to Aditya Dhar and Ranveer Singh as their film has smashed all the box office records. Trade experts expected a Tsunami when Dhurandhar: The Revenge released on March 19, and the spy thriller didn't disappoint. Dhurandhar 2 Worldwide Box Office Collection Day 6: Film Eyes 1000 Crore Mark On Day 7 Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge is maintaining strong momentum at the worldwide box office, passing the ₹900 crore mark in less than a week. The Ranveer Singh film has reached a total worldwide gross of ₹919.00 crore in six days, while also becoming the fastest Hindi title to clear ₹500 crore net in India. Within India, Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge has delivered ₹575.67 crore in net collections so far, backed by a solid weekday hold. The film’s total India gross has climbed to ₹687.43 crore, showing that audience interest remains high even after the first weekend surge. If the makers want to enter the Rs 1000-crore (gross) club on the seventh day, the film needs to perform exceedingly well on Wednesday. It looks difficult for the movie to achieve the mark on the seventh day, but it can complete the feat by Thursday night. Powered by: Dhurandhar 2 box office collection and day-wise India net trend On Day 6, which fell on the first Tuesday, Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge earned ₹56.55 crore net from 20,412 shows across the country. This follows a strong Monday figure of ₹65.00 crore net, reflecting only a 13 percent drop on Tuesday, which is considered healthy for a working weekday. The weekday stability comes after a big opening stretch, which began with paid previews on the first Wednesday. Early trade estimates noted strong evening occupancy on Tuesday as well, suggesting that Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge continues to attract repeat viewers and families alongside core fans of Ranveer Singh. Day India Net Collection Change(+/-) Day 0 [1st Wednesday] ₹43.00 Cr – Day 1 [1st Thursday] ₹102.55 Cr 138.5% Day 2 [1st Friday] ₹80.72 Cr -21.3% Day 3 [1st Saturday] ₹113.00 Cr 40.0% Day 4 [1st Sunday] ₹114.85 Cr 1.6% Day 5 [1st Monday] ₹65.00 Cr -43.4% Day 6 [1st Tuesday] ₹56.55 Cr -13.00% Total ₹575.67 Cr – Dhurandhar 2 box office collection and speed to 500 crore mark What stands out for Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge is not only the huge debut but also the sustained performance beyond the launch buzz. In just six days, the Hindi version has crossed around ₹575 crore net, making it the quickest film yet to go past the ₹500 crore net benchmark in the market.
